sections.heading: Planning your Coastal Cabana interior
sections.text:
East-facing coastal estates often bring a simple, useful design brief: plan for weather at the windows, keep floors practical, and build storage for family life — sports gear, school bags, bulk household goods — rather than decorating around a show-flat sofa. The joinery that usually carries that brief is an entry cabinet, a living-room storage wall, full-height bedroom wardrobes, and a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry. If a common room will be a study or a child’s room, a built-in desk along the window wall is more stable than a loose table. Maison specifies this as built-in carpentry, not as flat-pack furniture, and we can present the look in a wide room view or in closer material shots.

We have no official floor plan on file and will not invent typologies for this estate. Jalan Loyang Besar is a real road in a quieter eastern corner of the island; walking times to the beach, to Pasir Ris town, or to any MRT station are not something we will guess. Check your stack, facing and the management rules on balcony use before you plan screens, benches or outdoor cabinets.

Once a key date is in writing, the sequence is defects inspection, a measured survey, the management renovation application, then fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals; that is an editorial allowance, not a promise. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and, if you have it, the key letter. We are not affiliated with the developers.
